Generate a JSON Schema from an Excel File

Source: R/excel_to_json_schema.R
excel_to_json_schema.Rd

This function reads an Excel file and generates a JSON schema based on its structure. The schema includes column names and inferred data types.

Usage

excel_to_json_schema(excel_file, sheet_name = 1, json_file = NULL)

Arguments

excel_file

A character string specifying the path to the Excel file.

sheet_name

A character string or numeric value specifying the sheet to read. Defaults to 1 (the first sheet).

json_file

An optional character string specifying the path to save the JSON schema file. If NULL, the schema is returned as a string. Defaults to NULL.

Value

If json_file is NULL, returns a JSON-formatted schema string. If json_file is provided, the schema is saved to the file, and a message is printed indicating the file location.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Generate a JSON schema from the first sheet of "my_excel_file.xlsx"
schema <- excel_to_json_schema("my_excel_file.xlsx")
print(schema)

# Save the JSON schema to a file
excel_to_json_schema("my_excel_file.xlsx", json_file = "schema.json")
} # }
